# # Schema Change: Add Deactivation Support to User Groups

## Context

We've been getting requests from large organizations to be able to deactivate user groups without deleting them. Right now, deleting a group is permanent and breaks any references to it in stream permissions, message mentions, etc.

The plan is to add a `deactivated` boolean field to the `NamedUserGroup` model. The migration is already written (`zerver/migrations/0578_namedusergroup_deactivated.py`), but before we proceed I need a full impact analysis of what code needs to change.

## What I Need

1. **Schema change identification**: Confirm the migration and model change.

2. **Direct code references**: Find all Python code that queries, creates, updates, or filters `NamedUserGroup` objects. This includes the actions layer, views, and utility functions. We need to make sure deactivated groups are excluded from active queries but still accessible for admin operations.

3. **Indirect references**: This is the tricky part. The `NamedUserGroup` model touches:
   - The real-time event system (events sent to clients when groups change)
   - The API schema (OpenAPI spec in `zerver/openapi/`)
   - Realm import/export
   - Audit logging
   - Markdown rendering (group mentions like `@*groupname*`)
   - URL routing for group endpoints

   I need to know every place that needs to learn about the `deactivated` state.

4. **Test coverage**: Which test files exercise user group functionality and would need new test cases for deactivation scenarios?

Write your complete analysis to `/workspace/zulip/SCHEMA_IMPACT.md` with sections for each category above, including file paths and brief descriptions of required changes.


Search only these repositories: github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c

The full analysis is complete. Here is a summary of the key findings:

---

## Impact Analysis: `deactivated` on `NamedUserGroup`

The migration `0578_namedusergroup_deactivated.py` exists in the repo's file index but is not yet at HEAD. The model field still needs to be added to [`zerver/models/groups.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/models/groups.py?L35).

### Most Critical Changes (in priority order)

**1. Query layer — `zerver/lib/user_groups.py`**
- [`access_user_group_by_id()`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/lib/user_groups.py?L110-L126): does not filter deactivated groups — normal users will still be able to see/edit them.
- [`user_groups_in_realm_serialized()`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/lib/user_groups.py?L377-L435): `NamedUserGroup.objects.filter(realm=realm)` returns all groups. Either filter to active-only or add `deactivated` to `UserGroupDict` (line 47).
- [`update_or_create_user_group_for_setting()`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/lib/user_groups.py?L261-L292): deactivated groups can still be set as subgroups in permission settings.

**2. Markdown mentions — `zerver/lib/mention.py`**
- [`init_user_group_data()`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/lib/mention.py?L267-L276) resolves `@*groupname*` without a `deactivated=False` filter — deactivated groups will still highlight as mentions.

**3. Event system — `zerver/lib/event_schema.py`**
- [`group_type`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/lib/event_schema.py?L1810-L1821) (required keys for `op=add` events) and [`user_group_data_type`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/lib/event_schema.py?L1861-L1869) (optional keys for `op=update` events) both need `deactivated` added.
- [`do_send_create_user_group_event()`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/actions/user_groups.py?L168-L187) must include the field in the event payload.

**4. Import — `zerver/lib/import_realm.py`**
- [`bulk_import_named_user_groups()`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/lib/import_realm.py?L746-L767) uses a **raw SQL INSERT** with an explicit column list — `deactivated` must be manually added to both the column list and value tuple, or imports of realms with deactivated groups will fail or silently reset the field.
- Same issue in [`bulk_create_system_user_groups()`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/lib/user_groups.py?L594-L631).

**5. Audit log — `zerver/models/realm_audit_logs.py`**
- New event types `USER_GROUP_DEACTIVATED = 723` and `USER_GROUP_REACTIVATED = 724` needed (codes 720–722 are taken; 709–719 are reserved per the inline comment at [line 105](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/models/realm_audit_logs.py?L105)).

**6. Export** — `zerver/lib/export.py` requires **no code changes**; the ORM-based Config at [line 801](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/lib/export.py?L801-L807) will auto-export the new field.

**7. OpenAPI** — `zerver/openapi/zulip.yaml` and [`python_examples.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/openapi/python_examples.py?L806) need the field added to schemas and examples.

**8. Tests** — Primary files needing new deactivation cases: [`test_user_groups.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/tests/test_user_groups.py), [`test_events.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/tests/test_events.py?L1808), [`test_audit_log.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/tests/test_audit_log.py?L1105), [`test_markdown.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/tests/test_markdown.py?L2694), and [`test_import_export.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/zulip--38053e9c/-/blob/zerver/tests/test_import_export.py).
